column1: # voice-cue-census - every us event script that plays voice cues, joined to its own .vpc pack's VSP1 cue count (FABLE, 2026-09-18).
# cue indices: the last PUSHII before each voiceplay* CALLPOPA in the ff12-script decompile of the 1,115 us event containers; 127 is counted separately (it exceeds every pack's count).
# vsp1_count: the count word at +4 of the VSP1 block in PKFL slot 0 of ps2data/plan_master/us/event/<area>/<map>/<map>.vpc, read from the archive.
